{{Disadvantages|
*Slowest attack speed of all hammers.

==Unique Trait==
All Slam Attacks and stance combo slams inflict a forced Electricity proc, 1 in the area and multiple with a direct hit.
Kills with the weapon (including DoTs) grant the Slam Capacitor buff, increasing the damage of the next Slam Attack by 250% and its range by 2 meter per charge (max 5 charges).
*Unique trait does not affect non-slam attacks.
*The slam explosion can kill {{E|Nullifier Crewman}} Projector Drones, permanently disabling their bubbles.
*Damage increase is multiplicative to Seismic Wave and the Nira's Set bonus, and additive to base damage (e.g. Pressure Point, Arcane Fury).
*Up to 5 charges can be collected, they have infinite duration and are only consumed on a slam attack.
**Kills made with slam attacks do not grant Slam Capacitor charges, even on slams with no charges. However, kills from slam attack DoTs do grant charges.
**Damage and range bonuses stack additively with each charge, for a maximum slam damage increase of +1250% and a slam range increase of +10m with 5 charges.
**The charge amount can be seen with the electricity charged in the hammer. The current attack range is shown by an energy wave upon slamming.
*Melee combos in both Hammer Stance mods have built-in slam attacks which do not consume Slam Capacitor charges but do benefit from them.
**Those combo attacks perform true slams with innate 8m range at ground level, which increases to 18m with maximum Slam Capacitor charges.

==Notes==
*Normally this hammer benefits greatly from Melee Afflictions, even more so with charged Slam Capacitor.

weapons.notes:
==Characteristics==
*This weapon primarily deals Impact damage. 
*When wielded, the user can interact with enemy corpses (default {{Keybind|X}}) to Drain Enemy, spawning Health Orbs from organic enemies or Energy Orbs from robotic enemies.
**Drain Enemy ability locks the player into an uninterruptible animation for a moment, leaving them vulnerable to attack.
*Stance slot has a {{Pol|Unairu}} polarity, matches Flailing Branch.
*Innate {{Pol|Naramon}} polarity slot.

{{Advantages|
*Highest base damage of all staves.
*Second highest status chance of all staves, behind Bo Prime.
*Tied with Amphis for the second fastest attack speed of all staves, behind Tipedo.
}}

{{Disadvantages|
*Lowest critical chance of all staves.
}}

==Notes==
*When standing over an enemy corpse while wielding the Broken Scepter, the player gains the ability to drain the corpse by activating the Drain Enemy prompt on them by holding down on the Use Key (default {{Keybind|X}}). This will deconstruct the corpse in a manner similar to Capture targets, after which the corpse will release an orb. Organic enemies (such as Lancers) will release Health Orbs, while robotic enemies (such as MOAs) will release Energy Orbs instead. As the draining procedure consumes the corpse, this can only be done once per corpse.
**With proper timing, it's possible to both deconstruct and Desecrate a corpse.
*The Broken Scepter has two small orbs that orbit around it, which act as an indicator of how many times the player can use the Scepter's draining ability consecutively. One orb is consumed when performing a drain, and if both orbs are consumed the player will be unable to drain enemy corpses until the orbs regenerate.
**The orbs' trails remain visible even if the "Visible When Holstered" option is toggled off.
**Drain animation duration is roughly 2.5 seconds and orb regeneration happens after 10 seconds when an orb is consumed or 7.5 seconds after drain animation ends.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily Puncture damage.
*Slam Attacks deal only Magnetic damage.
*Can be wielded in-tandem with a single-handed secondary weapon.
*Holding the melee button throws the glaive, which can bounce up to three times or travels up to 30 meters before returning to the user, damaging anyone in its path. Meleeing while the glaive is in mid-flight commands it to return.
**Primary and secondary weapons can be fired and reloaded normally with a thrown glaive, and retrieving the glaive does not interrupt these actions. Additional throws can also be "buffered" while the glaive is in mid-flight.
**Thrown glaive has a guaranteed Impact proc.
**Thrown glaive has a 50% chance to disarm.
**Innate 1 meter punch through.
**Thrown glaive is silent.
**Heavy Attacks while the glaive is in mid-flight produces a 5.1 meter explosion and forces the glaive to return.
***Explosion inflicts a guaranteed Impact proc.
***Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
***No Damage Falloff.
***Explosion inflicts self-stagger.
***Explosion has a headshot multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions.
**Cannot use melee attacks or block while the glaive is in mid-flight.
*Can use the Glaive-exclusive mods Combo Fury, Power Throw, Quick Return (Volatile Quick Return), Rebound (Volatile Rebound), and Whirlwind.
*Stance slot has {{Pol|Naramon}} polarity, matching Gleaming Talon, Astral Twilight and Celestial Nightfall (Conclave only) stance.
*Two innate {{Pol|Madurai}} and one {{Pol|Naramon}} polarities.

{{Advantages|class=Glaive|}}

{{Disadvantages|class=Glaive|}}

{{WeaponComparison|Halikar}}
**Higher explosion radius (5.1m vs 4.9m)

==Notes==
*When equipping the Halikar Wraith, the player can throw it and then press the melee button to detonate the Halikar Wraith, dealing high AoE damage and returning to the player immediately. This is true for all thrown melee weapons.
**This is very useful for regenerating health with Life Strike.
**It can explode in this manner when not equipped and thrown, but the explosion timing cannot be controlled and will often stagger the user in close quarters.
**It should be however noted that finisher attacks can still be executed while the weapon is in the air.
*The Halikar Wraith is a unique weapon as it is the second equipable weapon (after Halikar) capable of disarming an enemy. This capability was initially reserved for Warframe abilities, including Radial Disarm.
**This capability is removed whilst under the effect of a Radiation Proc.
*Unlike the Glaive and the Kestrel, the Halikar Wraith has a limited degree of homing capability in-flight by gently curving its flight path via thrusters. However, this ability only benefits targeting at longer range and is lost after the first bounce.
*Certain enemies cannot be disarmed, e.g. Ospreys or Capture Targets.
*The Halikar has a base range similar to the Kestrel, or 3/4 that of the Glaive. Like with other thrown weapons, using Whirlwind on the Halikar will increase flight speed as well as distance traveled, because the flight time is constant. A fully levelled Whirlwind will increase the maximum distance to ~63m.
*When used within Clan Duels, the enemy will have their weapon removed permanently and the wielder will have their weapon slot replaced with the stolen weapon.
**Both the original weapon and the stolen weapon will be returned upon leaving the Clan Dojo.

weapons.name: Shadow Clones
weapons.notes:
==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals exclusively Finisher damage.
*This weapon deals a guaranteed Bleed status effect on hit. The proc damage scales only with Finisher damage and ignores Elemental mods and Finisher Damage Vulnerability (i.e. Savage Silence).
*Each enemy can be targeted only once per cast. However, the clones attack in pairs, so two enemies are attacked per second. 
*Utilizes the pseudo-exalted/Ability version of the Melee Combo system, receiving a damage multiplier of 1.0x per Combo Counter up to the cap of 12.0x.
**Default Combo Duration is Ability Duration5 seconds, with duration resetting on any combo generation.
***Duration is affected by mods (e.g., Body Count) and arcanes (e.g., Primary Dexterity).
***Duration is not affected by Amalgam Furax Body Count.
**Each enemy hit will increase combo count by 3 hits up to a maximum counter of 220 (12.0x). Since clones attack in pairs, this generates 6 combo per second for sufficiently large groups of enemies.   
***Enemy corpses count as enemies for combo generation on ability cast.
***Combo count is affected by Additional Combo Count Chance mods (e.g., Quickening, True Punishment, Relentless Combination), but each proc of the effect only awards one additional hit alongside the initial 3. Stacking mods to reach above 100% chance can award additional hits.
***Combo count is not affected by the Rauta.
**Initial Combo is affected by mods (e.g., Corrupt Charge, Galvanized Reflex).
***Even if the combo UI is not shown, Initial Combo does provide the corresponding damage multiplier.
**Combo Decay is reduced by the {{Focus|Power Spike}} passive from the {{Focus|Naramon}} focus school.
*Cannot perform blocking or heavy attacks and as such cannot equip related mods (e.g. Parry, Reflex Coil, Mentor's Legacy, Melee Animosity) and does not have an Exilus Slot.
**Cannot benefit from Carnis Mandible's heavy attack set effect.
*The animation speed benefits from Attack Speed mods such as Fury, but does not affect the limit of 2 clone attacks per second. 
*Can use the dagger-exclusive Covert Lethality mod.
*Is affected by Kullervo's Wrathful Advance
*Melee Crescendo will increase the initial ability combo count permanently, provided the affected enemies die directly to the finisher attacks.

==Notes==
Additional notes for Melee Crescendo: The ability combo counter HUD element will disappear as normal after the combo duration ends, but will reappear with further ability use below 220 combo and resume with the previously achieved combo count. Should one achieve 12x/220 initial combo with Melee Crescendo equipped and the combo duration be allowed to drop to zero, the HUD element will no longer appear for the rest of the mission/till death, but the 12x combo multiplier will still apply.

*This weapon deals primarily Puncture damage.
*Equipping Vinquibus will occupy both primary and melee weapon slots.
**Both forms gain an equal amount of Affinity and will thus rank up evenly.
***Vinquibus is counted as a single weapon in regards to earning Mastery Rank.
**Primary and melee forms are modded separately, using rifle and melee mods respectively.
***Riven Mods for primary and melee forms are generated separately.
**Orokin Catalyst, Focus Lens, Exilus Weapon Adapter, and Forma/Polarization are applied to both forms.
**Does not appear as an available loadout option in Deep Archimedea/Temporal Archimedea or Duviri.
*Innate one {{Pol|Madurai}} and one {{Pol|Aura}} polarities.

;Primary
*Headshots grant 2 stacks (max 16) of the Vinquibus Precision buff, increasing melee damage by 250%.
**Stacks are indicated on the right side of the reticle.
**Multishot and Punch Through can generate more stacks.
**Stacks are expended once the attack connects with an enemy. Attacks with multiple hits or connecting with multiple enemies will only consume 1 stack.
{{Advantages|name=Vinquibus (Primary)|class=Rifle|trigger=Semi-Auto|
}}

{{Disadvantages|name=Vinquibus (Primary)|class=Rifle|trigger=Semi-Auto|
}}

**Stacks are indicated on the left side of the reticle.
**Stacks are expended on shot, regardless whether or not they hit an enemy.
{{Advantages|name=Vinquibus (Melee)|
}}

{{Disadvantages|name=Vinquibus (Melee)|
}}

*Has a base 10 second Combo Duration, instead of 5.
*Using an Aerial Attack during Aim Glide launches glass projectiles that glasses and freezes enemies in-place for 7 seconds over 5 meters. Slam Attacking these glassed enemies will shatter them, inflicting reasonable damage.
**The glassing seems able to temporarily stun anything short of a boss at any level.
**Does not affect enemies with Overguard.

}}

{{Disadvantages|

}}

==Notes==
*While aim gliding, swinging the weapon for the first time will fire a projectile that glasses enemies, similar to Cephalites. Though the attack itself does not deal damage, glassed enemies are frozen in place for 7 seconds.
**The projectile flight speed can not be increased by mods or Zephyr's Jet Stream augment.
**The glass projectile can be controlled by Ivara's Navigator.
*When a ground slam is executed on a glassed enemy, the enemy will shatter and explode, dealing 999 damage.
**Slam Attacks, Heavy Attack Slams, and Stance Slams all trigger the glass explosion.
**Slam Attacks, Heavy Attack Slams, and Stance Slams will trigger a small "wave" of the sword's energy color that will travel in the direction of your Warframe on the ground at 40m/s, dealing 10 Impact damage and shattering glassed enemies. 
***Waves generated by normal slam attacks and stance slams travel for 1 second before dissipating, giving them a range of 40m. Each enemy hit by these waves will generate 1 point of combo, or 2 for glassed enemies.
***Waves generated by heavy slams travel for 2 seconds before disappearing, giving them an 80m range. The waves are also wider, force an Impact proc, and are brighter
****The waves generated by heavy slams count as heavy attacks and as such, benefit from the x2 increased critical chance bonus from True Steel. This bonus, along with the bonus from your current combo multiplier, will be applied to any glass explosions triggered by the waves.
**Glass explosion range is not affected by range mods such as Reach.
**Glass explosion has 100% status chance on the glassed enemy it originated from, which cannot be increase by normal status chance mods.
***Status chance can be increased by using Proton Snap.
***Explosion radial damage however shares the same status chance as the weapon (33%), including bonuses from status chance mods.
** Glass explosion damage is affected by elemental and physical damage mods on the glassed enemy it originated from, while explosion radial damage is not.

weapons.notes:
==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals equal physical damage.
*Utilizes the pseudo-exalted/Ability version of the Melee Combo system, receiving a damage multiplier of 1.0x per Combo Counter up to the cap of 12.0x.
**Default Combo Duration is Ability Duration5 seconds, with duration resetting on any combo generation.
***Duration is affected by mods (e.g., Body Count) and arcanes (e.g., Primary Dexterity).
***Duration is not affected by Amalgam Furax Body Count.
**Hitting at least one enemy on ability cast will increase combo count by 20 hits (+1.0x) up to a maximum counter of 220 (12.0x).
***Enemy corpses count as enemies for combo generation on ability cast.
***Combo count is affected by Additional Combo Count Chance mods (e.g., Quickening, True Punishment, Relentless Combination), but each proc of the effect only awards one additional hit alongside the initial 20. Stacking mods to reach above 100% chance can award additional hits.
***Combo count is not affected by the Rauta.
**Initial Combo is affected by mods (e.g., Corrupt Charge, Galvanized Reflex).
***Even if the combo UI is not shown, Initial Combo does provide the corresponding damage multiplier.
**Combo Decay is reduced by the {{Focus|Power Spike}} passive from the {{Focus|Naramon}} focus school.
*Cannot perform blocking or heavy attacks and as such cannot equip related mods (e.g. Parry, Reflex Coil, Mentor's Legacy, Melee Animosity) and does not have an Exilus Slot.
**Cannot benefit from Carnis Mandible's heavy attack set effect.
*Cannot perform Finishers and as such cannot equip Finishing Touch and Melee Crescendo.
*Does not benefit from Attack Speed and as such cannot equip Fury. 
**This means that Spoiled Strike provides no downside.
*Using Scourge/Scourge Prime's Alt fire that creates headshot bubbles will make the weapon deal more damage

==Notes==

* Interactions with arcanes
** Cannot equip certain arcanes: Melee Crescendo, Melee Animosity
** Despite not being able to Heavy Attack, Whipclaw is able to equip Melee Assimilation.
** Arcanes that affect combo duration equipped on other weapons(including Archguns) such as Primary Dexterity will increase the combo duration on Whipclaw
** Melee Afflictions works as expected
** Melee Vortex works as expected
** Melee Influence works as expected
** Melee Duplicate works as expected, though not recommended

weapons.name: Wolf Sledge
weapons.notes:
==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily Impact and Slash damage.
*Holding the melee button while on the ground throws the hammer in a similar manner to a Glaive, which travels up to 40 meters, bounces off one enemy to hit up to a second, and damages anyone in its return path. Meleeing while the hammer is in mid-flight commands it to return immediately.
**Primary and secondary weapons can be fired and reloaded normally with a thrown hammer, and retrieving the hammer does not interrupt these actions. Additional throws can also be "buffered" while the hammer is in mid-flight.
***Hitting an enemy with a thrown attack will cause it to seek one more target up to 20 meters behind the first before returning.
**Heavy Attacks while the hammer is in mid-flight produces a 5 meter explosion and forces the hammer to return.
***Explosion deals Blast damage.
***Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
***No Damage Falloff.
***Explosion inflicts self-stagger.
***Explosion has a headshot multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions.
***Explosion is affected by Heavy Attack bonuses such as True Steel 2x bonus, Killing Blow damage, and the combo multiplier.
**Hits from a thrown Sledge contribute to Melee Combo count.
**Cannot use the Glaive-exclusive "Thrown Melee" mods such as Volatile Quick Return despite being a thrown melee.
**Cannot be thrown in mid-air, instead performing standard hammer melee attacks or slams.
*Stance polarity {{Pol|Madurai}} matches Crushing Ruin.

{{Advantages|
*Third highest status chance of all hammers, behind Arca Titron and Synoid Heliocor.
}}

{{Disadvantages|
*Cannot use melee attacks or block while the hammer is in mid-flight.
}}

{{clr}}
{{Acquisition|Wolf Sledge's main blueprint and components can be acquired as random drops after defeating the Wolf of Saturn Six. All parts are tradeable between players.}}
{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*Holding the melee key for 200{{text||ms|hover=miliseconds}} will begin to charge a unique throw attack. The warframe will throw the Wolf Sledge, which will attempt to seek the nearest enemy as they enter the its line-of-sight. After hitting an enemy, the Wolf Sledge will attempt to seek another enemy, but only if it is possible for homing turn-rate to maneuver to the target. The Wolf Sledge can be detonated any time in its flight by pressing the heavy attack key.
**Charge level does not affect damage.
**Charge Time and short throwing animation is affected by Attack Speed mods. Charge time is {{text||not affected by Wind-up|hover=The charging reticle is affected by heavy wind-up bonuses, but it is only visual.}}.
***When using no stance, similarly to heavy attacks and Glaive throws, the charge time is affected by wind-up bonuses, not by attack speed bonuses, while the throwing animation remains affected by attack speed bonuses.
**Travels up to 40m, but can bounce off a target to one more enemy up to 20m behind the first.
***Projectile speed and distance is affected by Jet Stream, but not the homing turn-rate, sacrificing the homing capability.
**While traveling outward, the projectile produces a 5 meter explosion on each strike.
***Hitting terrain will produce an explosion but force the hammer to immediately return.
***Hammer does not explode on return hits.
**Hits contribute to the combo multiplier. Explosion hits do not.
**Can be manually recalled by pressing the melee key.
***Upon return, Wolf Sledge ignores terrain and strikes everything in its path.
***Projectile width is not affected by Reach mods.
**If the melee key is held as the hammer returns to your hands, it will "{{text||Buffer|hover=Buffering inputs in video games refers to preemptively pressing inputs to sequence actions so they are executed as fast as they are ready, as opposed to pressing a key as you see it ready, which adds human delays.}}" the attack and pre-count the 200ms hold-delay to immediately begin charging another throw.
***Cannot be buffered after certain combo animations or thrown mid-air.{{exp|[Needs Clarification]}}
**Can be detonated any time in flight by pressing the heavy attack key.
***Recall Explosion is a Heavy Attack and benefits from all heavy bonuses such as True Steel's 2x bonus, Killing Blow's damage, the combo multiplier and even Life Strike. It will consume the combo counter and reset its timer.
***Heavy Explosion will Ragdoll enemies. It also applies a ridiculous force to send ragdolls flying.
***Recall explosion causes self-stagger.
***Activating heavy explosion causes the hammer to return if not already returning. Returning this way causes all return strikes to be heavy hits, benefiting from heavy bonuses just like the heavy explosion.
*Despite being throwable, it cannot equip Glaive-exclusive "Thrown" mods such as Power Throw and Rebound.
*Mirage's Hall of Mirrors throws five hammers.

**Highest explosion radius of all glaives.
